en.headline: Know the page before you edit it.
en.description: Inspect PDF page boxes, visible dimensions, rotation, UserUnit and metadata with a small local, read-only command-line tool.
en.boundary: No OCR, rendering, repair, signature validation or secure redaction. Geometry findings are review prompts, not a PDF compliance certificate.
en.about_description: The PDF Geometry Desk maintenance relationship and the limits of its local page inspection.
en.about:
Maintained in the related-product ecosystem

Vesper2026 maintains this MIT-licensed utility and site within the same maintenance team as the related Eqvero, KolmoPDF and KomoPDF ecosystem. We disclose that connection rather than present this as an independent product review.

The CLI uses pypdf in your own Python environment. It reads local files, writes reports and does not upload PDFs. The static website has no upload form, analytics or accounts. Dependency installation contacts the package index; Vercel hosts the production website; GitHub retains the source and Pages copy.

Inspection and editing are different jobs

KomoPDF is the related PDF editing product. This utility helps identify geometry questions before editing; it does not implement the editor, modify pages or guarantee that any particular editing operation preserves signatures.

Metadata strings come from the file itself and can be absent or incorrect. Neither an ordinary author field nor a clean geometry report proves provenance, confidentiality or document authenticity.
en.footer: Vesper2026 · Read-only PDF inspection · MIT tool · Affiliation disclosed
en.home_context_html: Read the page facts before deciding what to change in KomoPDF, the related PDF editor. This local preflight does not edit the file or promise that unusual geometry needs repair.

en.title: Why two A4 PDF pages can have different visible dimensions
en.description: Inspect a three-page synthetic PDF and distinguish media size, clipping and rotation before opening an editor.
en.body:
A file can mix A4 portrait, rotated A4 and cropped Letter pages without being corrupt. The useful question is what each page's boxes and rotation actually describe. This walkthrough uses blank, synthetic pages so no customer document is needed.

1. Create an isolated environment

Install Python 3.10 or newer. From the repository root, create a project environment and install the pinned runtime dependency.

python -m venv .venv
# Windows PowerShell
.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/Scripts/python.exe examples/generate_sample.py
.venv/Scripts/python.exe pdf_geometry.py examples/sample.pdf --output examples/output

On macOS or Linux, replace .venv/Scripts/python.exe with .venv/bin/python. The generated sample PDF is also available for inspection, alongside its JSON report and readable report.

2. Compare what is visible

Page 1 has an A4 MediaBox. Page 2 has the same unrotated box but a 90-degree page rotation, so its displayed width and height exchange places. Page 3 uses a Letter MediaBox with a smaller CropBox. For CropBox coordinates [18,36,594,756], the width is 594−18=576 and height is 756−36=720 default units. At UserUnit 1 this is 203.2 × 254 mm.

3. Keep the inspection separate from an edit

The CLI writes reports without modifying the PDF. Use the page numbers and box values to decide whether an edit is needed; a mixed-size group is not itself an error. If you choose to edit, KomoPDF is the related product, but this report does not promise that the editor automatically repairs every unusual file.

The sample has blank pages and metadata, not meaningful page content. The tool cannot determine reading order, text editability, OCR quality, print bleed suitability or digital-signature validity.

zh-Hant.title: 同樣是 A4，PDF 的可見尺寸為何不同？
zh-Hant.description: 檢查三頁合成 PDF，分清頁面框、裁切與旋轉，再決定是否需要編輯。
zh-Hant.body:
同一份檔案可以混合直向 A4、旋轉 A4 與裁切後的 Letter，這不必然表示損壞。真正需要了解的是每頁的頁面框與旋轉值。練習使用空白合成頁，不需要客戶文件。

1. 建立隔離環境

準備 Python 3.10 或更新版本，在儲存庫根目錄建立專案環境並安裝固定版本依賴。

python -m venv .venv
# Windows PowerShell
.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/Scripts/python.exe examples/generate_sample.py
.venv/Scripts/python.exe pdf_geometry.py examples/sample.pdf --output examples/output

macOS 或 Linux 將 .venv/Scripts/python.exe 換成 .venv/bin/python。可直接下載產生的範例 PDF，對照 JSON 報告與文字報告。

2. 比較實際可見範圍

第 1 頁是 A4 MediaBox；第 2 頁使用相同的未旋轉頁面框，但頁面旋轉為 90 度，所以顯示寬高互換。第 3 頁是 Letter MediaBox，配上較小的 CropBox。若裁切座標為 [18,36,594,756]，寬度是 594−18=576，高度是 756−36=720。UserUnit 為 1 時，可見尺寸為 203.2 × 254 毫米。

3. 檢查不等於編輯

CLI 只輸出報告，不改寫 PDF。根據頁碼與頁面框決定是否需要處理；混合尺寸本身並非錯誤。需要編輯時，可使用相關的 KomoPDF，但本報告不代表編輯器可以自動修復所有特殊檔案。

範例只有空白頁面與中繼資料，沒有實際正文。工具不能判斷閱讀順序、文字可編輯性、OCR 品質、印刷出血是否合適，或數位簽章是否有效。

en.title: MediaBox, CropBox and UserUnit: the limits of a geometry preflight
en.description: Understand intersection-based visible size, quarter-turn rotation, metadata and restricted encrypted files.
en.body:
A PDF rectangle is a coordinate range, not automatically a physical sheet measurement. To interpret it, keep the raw coordinates, effective clipping and scale separate.

Compute a visible rectangle, then scale it

The inspector retains MediaBox and CropBox and uses their intersection for the effective visible area. For two rectangles, the left and bottom edges are the maxima of their corresponding edges; right and top are the minima. A CropBox outside the MediaBox is reported even if the intersection still has a useful area. An empty intersection is not assigned a made-up positive size.

width_pt  = (right - left) × UserUnit
height_pt = (top - bottom) × UserUnit
mm        = pt × 25.4 / 72

At UserUnit 2, a 300-unit width measures 600 points, not 300. After scaling, a quarter-turn rotation of 90 or 270 degrees swaps width and height. Zero or 180 degrees does not. Non-quarter-turn values are flagged rather than presented as a trustworthy normal displayed size.

Use groups as a navigation aid

Dimensions are rounded for reporting and grouping. A group that differs from the most common page size is an inspection cue, not evidence that the page is broken. A document may intentionally include foldouts, inserts or landscape tables. The report does not render page content or inspect every optional PDF page box.

Read metadata cautiously

Title, author and creator fields are statements stored in the file; they may be absent, stale or forged. A missing author is not proof of anonymization, and an author string is not identity verification. The tool does not inspect hidden content for privacy or validate signatures.

An encrypted file that cannot be opened without a password is reported as restricted, without invented page details. The utility does not crack passwords or bypass permissions. Successful parsing is also not a comprehensive PDF conformance test. Keep the original and make editing decisions in a separate workflow.

If the geometry warrants an intentional edit, KomoPDF is the related editing product. Carry the page number and box values into that separate decision; this inspection does not guarantee repair, signature preservation or secure redaction.

zh-Hant.title: MediaBox、CropBox 與 UserUnit：幾何預檢能回答到哪裡？
zh-Hant.description: 了解交集可見尺寸、四分之一圈旋轉、中繼資料，以及受限加密檔案。
zh-Hant.body:
PDF 矩形首先是一組座標範圍，不會自動等於實體紙張尺寸。解讀時必須分開原始座標、有效裁切與縮放。

先取可見交集，再換算單位

工具保留 MediaBox 與 CropBox，以兩者交集作為有效可見範圍。左、下邊界分別取兩框對應邊界的較大值；右、上邊界則取較小值。即使交集仍有面積，CropBox 超出 MediaBox 也會提示；交集為空時，不會編造正尺寸。

寬度 pt = (右 - 左) × UserUnit
高度 pt = (上 - 下) × UserUnit
毫米 = pt × 25.4 / 72

UserUnit 為 2 時，300 座標單位的寬度是 600 點，不是 300 點。換算後，90 或 270 度旋轉會互換寬高，0 或 180 度則不換。非四分之一圈的旋轉值會被標示，不當成可靠的正常顯示尺寸。

分組只是定位輔助

尺寸會四捨五入後顯示和分組。與最常見尺寸不同的頁面只是檢查線索，不表示損壞；折頁、插頁與橫向表格都可能是刻意安排。報告不渲染正文，也不檢查每一種可選 PDF 頁面框。

謹慎解讀中繼資料

標題、作者與建立程式是檔案內儲存的聲明，可能缺失、過時或偽造。沒有作者不代表完成匿名化，有作者字串也不代表核實身分。工具不搜尋隱藏隱私資料，不驗證簽章。

無法在不提供密碼的情況下開啟的加密檔案，會回報受限，不會捏造頁面明細。工具不破解密碼或繞過權限。成功解析也不等於完整 PDF 合規檢查；保留原檔，並在另一個工作流程中決定編輯方式。

若確認幾何需要刻意調整，可把頁碼與頁面框數值帶到相關的 KomoPDF 編輯產品中另行處理。預檢不保證修復效果、簽章保留或安全遮蔽。
